name: Head of Targorr
summary: In the Stormwind Stockade, Targorr the Dread awaits an execution stopped by nobles in Stormwind. Once Gath'Ilzogg's supreme executioner in the Redridge Mountains, the captured orc is now the subject of Guard Berton's demand for proof of his death in Lakeshire.

sections.title: A Delayed Execution
sections.body: Targorr the Dread earned infamy across Redridge as the Blackrock clan warlord Gath'Ilzogg's brutal executioner. He tortured and slaughtered defenders of the Kingdom of Stormwind before his capture and death sentence in the Stormwind Stockade. Stormwind nobles intervened and mysteriously suspended the sentence. Guardsmen like Berton suspect foul play and corruption in the capital.

sections.title: Frontier Justice
sections.body: Guard Berton fears Targorr could become a political pawn or arrange an escape, so he hires an outside champion to enter the volatile prison and finish what the courts delayed. Taking Targorr's head bypasses the stalled legal system and gives closure to grieving families and Lakeshire's besieged defenders, who suffered under the executioner's blades.

faq.answer: Targorr the Dread was an infamous orc executioner of the Blackrock clan in Redridge. Under the warlord Gath'Ilzogg, he tortured and executed captured Stormwind soldiers and defenders.

faq.q: Why was Targorr kept alive in the Stockade?
faq.answer: Stormwind nobles mysteriously halted Targorr's death sentence through bureaucratic intervention. Lakeshire guards suspect political foul play and corruption, and fear he is being kept as a bargaining chip.

Guard Berton, stationed outside the Lakeshire Inn, wants Targorr's severed head. After seeing the carnage he caused in the Redridge Mountains, Berton seeks proof that the executioner can never be freed.
Targorr the Dread is held in the Stormwind Stockade, behind iron bars in the central cell blocks with rioting inmates.

angles.text: For Alliance champions defending Redridge, Targorr's death avenges the slaughtered defenders of Lakeshire and bypasses corrupt noble bureaucracy in Stormwind.
As a human, you may share the soldiers' and town guards' grudge against Targorr for torturing captured Kingdom troops during the Blackrock offensive.
